#define DEBUG_SHAPES
#nullable enable
using System;

namespace Geometry.Diagnostics
{
#if DEBUG_SHAPES
    public class Tracer
    {
#region Fields
        private readonly Owner _owner;
#endregion
        [Conditional("DEBUG")]
        public void Trace(string message)
        {
#pragma warning disable CS0618
            Console.WriteLine(message);
#pragma warning restore CS0618
        }
    }
#else
    public class Tracer { }
#endif
}
